name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities
measures: Vulnerabilities confirmed as exploited in the wild
about: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency lists software vulnerabilities with evidence of real-world exploitation. It is the only series here counted the same way across every year, so the Security signal uses it for its headline number.
limitations: It counts when CISA added a vulnerability, not when it was first exploited.
It only covers vulnerabilities CISA knows about and considers actionable, so it undercounts total exploitation.
Its first years include a bulk load of older vulnerabilities, so the trend starts in 2023.
attribution: Data from the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Use does not imply endorsement by CISA or DHS. We count entries and publish the results.
